How It Works

Our 3-Step Process

Every garden we build follows a clear, transparent process with no surprises and no delays. You're kept in the loop at every stage via WhatsApp updates.

🌿
1
Concept Consultation

We visit your space (balcony, terrace, villa, or office) and understand your vision, lifestyle, and maintenance capacity. We factor in Bangalore's climate, your sun exposure, water access, and space dimensions to suggest the right plants and design approach. You receive a mood board and plant selection within 48 hours.

Site visit Plant selection Design concept
→
📋
2
Estimate & Quotation

We provide a detailed, itemised quote covering plants, pots, structural elements, labour, and any accessories. No hidden charges. We offer three budget tiers so you can choose what works for you. Once you confirm, we lock in a date and procure plants fresh from our trusted nursery sources to ensure quality.

Transparent pricing No hidden costs Budget tiers
→
🏡
3
Setup & Installation

Our team arrives on the confirmed date and completes the setup, typically within 1 to 3 days depending on scale. You receive WhatsApp photo updates through the day. Once done, we walk you through care instructions, watering schedules, and connect you to our AMC for ongoing maintenance. Your plants are covered under our 15-day guarantee.

What We Set Up

Gardens We Design & Set Up in Bengaluru

From compact balconies to full villa landscapes, here's what we design, build and maintain for homes and offices across Bengaluru.

Balcony Garden Setup

Space-smart balcony gardens with planters, vertical greenery and seating for apartments across Bengaluru.

Terrace Garden Setup

Rooftop and terrace gardens designed for sunlight, drainage and low-maintenance upkeep.

Villa Garden Setup

End-to-end villa garden design and landscaping: lawns, beds, pathways and feature plants.

Corporate / Office Garden

Office and corporate green spaces, biophilic interiors and living walls that lift the workplace.

Vertical Garden

Living green walls and vertical gardens for homes, offices and compact urban spaces.

Kitchen Garden

Grow-your-own kitchen gardens with vegetables and everyday greens, right at home.

Herbs & Medicinal Garden

Herb and medicinal plant gardens with tulsi, mint, aloe, lemongrass and more.

Fruit Garden

Fruit and exotic-fruit plant gardens chosen to thrive in Bengaluru's climate.
